pages.views: ld_score - SELECT ld.*, (SELECT SUM(((LENGTH(LOWER(ld.content)) - LENGTH(REPLACE(LOWER(ld.content), LOWER(k.keyword), ''))) / LENGTH(k.keyword)) * k.weight) FROM tbl_keywords AS k WHERE k.type = 'role') AS content_score FROM ld;

pages.resume:
# Professional Summary

Analytics leader with 10+ years of progression from data engineering and BI development to enterprise analytics strategy, currently heading global commercial analytics at a top-tier international firm. Builds KPI frameworks, data governance standards, and cross-functional teams that turn fragmented data into executive decisions — recovering millions in revenue and cutting cycle times.

# Core Competencies

* **Data & Analytics Strategy:** Enterprise Analytics Strategy, KPI Design & Performance Measurement, Data Governance & Risk Management, Data-Driven Decision Making, Financial & Pricing Analytics
* **Technical Proficiency:** Python, PySpark, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel/VBA, Informatica PowerCenter, Azure Data Lakes
* **Data & Systems Architecture:** ETL/Data Pipeline Design, Data Modeling, Big Data Processing, Data Warehousing, Data Quality & QA
* **Leadership & Stakeholder Management:** Global Team Leadership, Executive Communication & Presentation, Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management, Change Management
* **Methodologies:** Agile/Scrum, Process Automation, Market & Competitive Analysis, Reporting Standardization

# Professional Experience

## Senior Manager | Clifford Chance

**Mar 2026 – Present**

* Designed and implemented a 360-degree partner performance framework spanning Billing, Supervising, and Business Generating Partner roles, iterating KPIs with global stakeholders before deploying to Power BI as the firm's global standard for equity partner promotion decisions.
* Spearheaded the analytics transition supporting a company-wide reorganization from regional structures to Global Product Groups, rebuilding the database architecture to sustain uninterrupted analytics-driven decision-making.
* Lead a global commercial analytics team, embedding analytics frameworks and stakeholder engagement into business strategy to strengthen firm-wide collaboration and decision quality.
* Spearheaded a reporting standardization initiative that eliminated duplicate reports, freeing up significant analytics team bandwidth for higher-value work.

## Manager | Clifford Chance

**Nov 2023 – Feb 2026**

* Developed advanced analytics frameworks and Power BI dashboards on firm-wide client and matter data, partnering with finance and pricing teams to lift financial recovery from 35% to 54%.
* Automated manual reporting workflows using Python, cutting analysis time by 83% while improving data accuracy across the analytics team.
* Consolidated fragmented client data into centralized performance dashboards for the full client portfolio, improving relationship management effectiveness.

## Lead Analyst | Stryker

**Jun 2023 – Nov 2023**

* Designed and maintained PySpark ETL pipelines processing over 500GB of data daily, applying data modeling and validation frameworks that improved ETL efficiency by 45%.
* Led integration of 13 disparate ERP systems into a unified platform and contributed to a machine-learning-based Customer Master, establishing a single source of truth for enterprise customer data.

## Consultant | Ernst & Young (EY)

**Jun 2021 – May 2023**

* Led multiple global teams on order-to-cash applications for a $500M+ business portfolio, designing a process improvement strategy that lifted team productivity by 25%.
* Established a firm-wide incident management process with a KPI-driven performance dashboard spanning 15+ stakeholders, cutting average resolution time by 40%.
* Architected a PySpark data transformation framework unifying large datasets across multiple Azure data lakes, enabling faster, more reliable data extraction for technology teams.

## Lead Associate, Business Insights (Europe) | WNS Global Services

**Apr 2019 – May 2021**

* Directed design and delivery of commercial dashboards and financial reporting spanning 12 products across 4 international markets, enabling faster leadership decision-making and forecasting.
* Built a leaner QA methodology and Python-based automation for finance reporting, cutting report delivery time by 20% and data processing time by 95%.

## Senior Engineer | Infosys

**Sep 2017 – Mar 2019**

* Led development of executive dashboards, scorecards, and BI solutions in Excel, Tableau, and VBA, owning the full reporting lifecycle across multiple business units.
* Bridged business and technical teams on reporting requirements and UAT, redesigning the employee database with design-thinking principles to cut query response time by 33%.

## Engineer | Infosys

**Sep 2015 – Aug 2017**

* Designed automated ETL process chains in SAP BW/HANA, reducing organization-wide data processing time by 35% and establishing a repeatable data pipeline.
* Automated JIRA and Confluence project setup using JavaScript and UNIX scripting, eliminating manual configuration work across all new project launches.

# Education & Certifications

* **Bachelor of Technology, Computer Science** | Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University | 2015
* **Certified Scrum Master (CSM)** | Scrum Alliance
* **Analytics – Data Science Badge** | EY TechMBA Programme (Ernst & Young)
* **Business Intelligence & Analytics Foundation Training** | Infosys Ltd. | 2015–16
